original: No one's around. Tentomon, come\nover here!
So this is your place, Koushirou?
Hey, it's the first time you're\nseein' her in a while. Aren't'cha\nbein' a bit blunt?
Hey, dear. When are we going to\ntell him the truth?
Why don't we wait a bit longer? If\nwe tell Koushirou now, it'll be a\nreally big shock.
But I wonder if he's already\nrealized it by now...
That he's not our real son. That\nhe's adopted...
Looks like we've received an\ne-mail... from Gennai?!
This is bad! An unidentified\nDigimon has landed in Shibaura!
I'd feel right better 'bout this\nif the others were here, but...
Can't help it. I'll just have to\nwing it on my own some way.
We have to do something before he\nturns around and notices us!
We managed to floor him by\nourselves...
The eighth child must be nearby!
You aren't chasing the eighth\nchild's signal, are you?!
We won't letcha have the eighth\nChosen Child!
But at least now we know the\neighth child isn't around\nHikarigaoka...
We've learned enough. It seems\nthat Taichi's suspicions were\ncorrect.
I just saw a cat over there that\nlooks similar to Taichi's cat.
I don't know. Maybe it hid some\nfood around here?
Hahaha. I'll bring you something\nwhen we get home.
